Topics · Meaning and purpose

What would faith change in my ordinary week?

Your honest measure is already yours. The change is a direction for the same hours, not more hours.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:35

Translation

“‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity. You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

Original · Hebrew

לֹא־תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֖וֶל בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט בַּמִּדָּ֕ה בַּמִּשְׁקָ֖ל וּבַמְּשׂוּרָֽה׃ מֹ֧אזְנֵי צֶ֣דֶק אַבְנֵי־צֶ֗דֶק אֵ֥יפַת צֶ֛דֶק וְהִ֥ין צֶ֖דֶק יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

the Torah (Leviticus) · 19:35-36

World English Bible

Start with a Monday you already live. You hand over what you promised, give full measure, keep the account straight when no one checks. Many people do this without any religion, and it is worth a great deal. This passage speaks to exactly this: give full measure when you measure, and weigh with a straight balance; that is better, and better in its outcome. Belief does not invent your honesty. It meets it where it already is.

A question for you

Which part of your Monday has your most honest measure?

If you sayMy work.
ThenWork is the first field the verse names.
If you sayMy family.
ThenIn a family the balance is finest, because everyone knows the true weight.
If you sayNothing is that exact.
ThenThat is an honest answer. The verse asks for a straight balance, and 6:152 adds that no soul is charged beyond its capacity.

Part 2 of 3

﴿قُلْ إِنَّ صَلَاتِى وَنُسُكِى وَمَحْيَاىَ وَمَمَاتِى لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

Quran · Al-An'am 6:162

Translation

Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you. My soul, you have said to Yahweh, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

Original · Hebrew

מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃ אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־עָלֶֽיךָ׃

the Psalms · 16:1-2

World English Bible

The next verse says: my prayer, my devotion, my living and my dying are for God, Lord of the worlds. It does not say 'religion occupies my Mondays'. It says Monday itself is offered. The tasks stay the same: dishes, email, trains. What changes is whom the day is for. A belief changes this one thing: not more hours, but a direction for the same hours.

A question for you

What is Monday for, to you?

If you sayGetting through it.
ThenThat is honest for many people. The verse offers a direction instead, not longer hours.
If you sayProviding for people I love.
ThenA noble purpose, and the verse has room for it, adding that what is done for them can also be offered.
If you saySomething I have not named yet.
ThenThat is a good place to start. The name may come.

Part 3 of 3

﴿إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, Allāh orders justice and good conduct and giving [help] to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

Quran · An-Nahl 16:90

Translation

Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.

Original · Hebrew

וְאַתָּ֖ה בֵּאלֹהֶ֣יךָ תָשׁ֑וּב חֶ֤סֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט֙ שְׁמֹ֔ר וְקַוֵּ֥ה אֶל־אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ תָּמִֽיד׃

Hosea · 12:6

World English Bible

If belief changes a Monday, what would show? The Quran names it in one verse: justice, kindness, generosity to relatives, and staying clear of shamelessness, harm and oppression. Notice how ordinary this is. A colleague treated fairly. A neighbour helped. A mother called. If you already live like this, belief would not hand you a new life. It would give that life a direction, and Someone to turn to.

A question for you

What would you want belief to add to a Monday you already live honestly?

If you sayMeaning.
ThenMeaning is what the 'for God' verse offers: a direction for the hours.
If you sayHope.
ThenHope comes when good has weight before One with whom no one is wronged.
If you sayNothing.
ThenThen your list and the verse's list already agree. This Step asks only what stands behind them.

The same in the other books

Translation

Yahweh detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

Original · Hebrew

תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה אֶ֣בֶן וָאָ֑בֶן וּמֹאזְנֵ֖י מִרְמָ֣ה לֹא־טֽוֹב׃

Proverbs · 20:23

World English Bible

Translation

“‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am Yahweh. The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

Original · Hebrew

לֹֽא־תִקֹּ֤ם וְלֹֽא־תִטֹּר֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔ךָ וְאָֽהַבְתָּ֥ לְרֵעֲךָ֖ כָּמ֑וֹךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ כְּאֶזְרָ֣ח מִכֶּם֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם הַגֵּ֣ר ׀ הַגָּ֣ר אִתְּכֶ֗ם וְאָהַבְתָּ֥ לוֹ֙ כָּמ֔וֹךָ כִּֽי־גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

the Torah (Leviticus) · 19:18, 34

World English Bible

Translation

Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it. Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

Original · Hebrew

ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב בַּקֵּ֖שׁ שָׁל֣וֹם וְרָדְפֵֽהוּ׃ עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה אֶל־צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְ֝אָזְנָ֗יו אֶל־שַׁוְעָתָֽם׃

the Psalms · 34:14-15

World English Bible

Translation

As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

Original · Ancient Greek

Καὶ ἐκπορευομένου αὐτοῦ εἰς ὁδὸν προσδραμὼν εἷς καὶ γονυπετήσας αὐτὸν ἐπηρώτα αὐτόν· Διδάσκαλε ἀγαθέ, τί ποιήσω ἵνα ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσω;
